name: ACE-Step 1.5 Music
author: DrHepa
description: Local text-to-music with ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo, optional lyrics and 5Hz music planning. Setup downloads persistent weights once.

params_schema.label: Music description (fallback)
params_schema.tooltip: Connect a Text node with the music description, or enter it here. Connected text takes priority.

params_schema.label: Lyrics
params_schema.tooltip: Optional lyrics with [Verse]/[Chorus] tags. Literal \n is accepted as a line break. Ignored in instrumental mode.

params_schema.label: Duration (seconds)
params_schema.tooltip: Start with 10-30 seconds. Long tracks need substantially more RAM/VRAM; the host GPU limit is checked before generation.

params_schema.label: Key / scale
params_schema.tooltip: Optional, for example C major or A minor.

params_schema.label: Vocal language
params_schema.tooltip: Upstream language code, for example en, es, ja or unknown.

params_schema.label: 5Hz music planner (1.7B)
params_schema.tooltip: Uses the bundled local 1.7B LM for music codes and missing metadata. More memory/startup time; it does not write lyrics automatically.

params_schema.label: Memory mode
params_schema.tooltip: Offload reduces VRAM use at the cost of speed. This release does not quantize weights.
